summary: Introduces the ListSkuGroups public API to list rebilling-supported SKU groups that can be configured in customer or channel partner repricing.
extended_definition: Introduces the ListSkuGroups public API to list rebilling-supported SKU groups that can be configured in customer or channel partner repricing.

supporting_pages.title: "Create and manage repricing configurations \_|\_ Channel Services \_|\_\
evidence_snippets: The resulting data in Rebilling BQ Export looks like the following: sku list price cost customer cost credit.type credit.amount credit.customer amount Partner Cost (cost + SUM(credit.amount)) End Customer Cost (customer cost + SUM(credit.customer amount)) Compute 120 100 99.6 (120 .83) RESELLER MARGIN COMMITTED USAGE DISCOUNT -10 -10 0 (margin hidden) 0 (hidden due to list price) 80 99.6 BigQuery 120 100 120 (100 1.2) RESELLER MARGIN COMMITTED USAGE DISCOUNT -10 -10 0 (margin hidden) -12 (DCC+20%) 80 108 Note: If an entitlement does not have any repricing configuration specified, then it defaults to Direct Customer Cost + 0% , which implies no modifications to the cost (except removal of RESELLER MARGIN).
You can use custom repricing configurations to markup or discount direct customer costs, list prices, and specific SKU groups by a set percentage.
You can also export SKU groups using the API, with the List SKU groups and List billable SKUs in a SKU group endpoints.
